<title>Mahnoor Ansari | Designer. Developer. Artist.</title>

<style>
:root{--bg:#0e0e0e;--p:#171717;--t:#f1ece1;--m:#9a958a;--g:#c9a96a;--l:rgba(241,236,225,.12)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--t);font:300 1rem/1.7 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;line-height:1.05}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.w{width:min(1120px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto}
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(14,14,14,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--l)}
nav .w{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;height:68px}
.lg{font:600 1.4rem "Cormorant Garamond",serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--g)}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:26px;list-style:none;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}nav li a:hover{color:var(--g)}
.hero{min-height:88vh;display:grid;align-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 75% 30%,#2a2216,transparent 55%)}
.eb{color:var(--g);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-size:clamp(3.4rem,10vw,8rem)}h1 em{color:var(--g);font-weight:500}
.hero p{max-width:520px;color:var(--m);margin:26px 0 34px;font-size:1.1rem;font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif;font-style:italic}
.b{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--g);color:var(--g);padding:13px 28px;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.25s;cursor:pointer;background:none}
.b:hover,.b.on{background:var(--g);color:#111}
section{padding:96px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--l)}h2{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,3.8rem);margin-bottom:12px}h2 span{color:var(--g)}
.sub{color:var(--m);max-width:520px;margin-bottom:30px}
.ab{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:56px}.ab p{color:#cfcabd;margin-bottom:16px}
.sk{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-content:start}.sk span{border:1px solid var(--l);padding:8px 16px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--m)}
.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:28px}.tabs .b{padding:9px 18px;border-color:var(--l);color:var(--m)}
.gr{columns:3 260px;column-gap:16px}.it{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;cursor:zoom-in;background:var(--p);overflow:hidden}
.it img{width:100%;display:block;transition:.4s}.it:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.it small{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;right:0;padding:26px 14px 10px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.85));font-size:.78rem;opacity:0;transition:.3s}.it:hover small{opacity:1}
.tag{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;background:rgba(14,14,14,.8);border:1px solid var(--g);color:var(--g);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 9px}
.web{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px}
.card{background:var(--p);border:1px solid var(--l);transition:.3s}.card:hover{border-color:var(--g);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.fr{position:relative;margin:16px 16px 0;border:1px solid var(--l);border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;background:#222}
.fr:before{content:"";display:block;height:22px;background:#262626 radial-gradient(circle at 12px 11px,#c96 3px,transparent 4px) no-repeat}
.fr img{width:100%;display:block}.fr .in{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;width:34%;border:2px solid var(--g);border-radius:6px}
.cb{padding:22px}.cb h3{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:8px}.cb p{color:var(--m);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:14px}.cb .st{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--g);margin-bottom:16px}
.ct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}.ct a.row{display:block;border-bottom:1px solid var(--l);padding:16px 0;font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif;font-size:clamp(1.15rem,4.8vw,1.6rem)}.ct a.row small{display:block;font:300 .7rem Inter;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--g)}.ct a.row:hover{color:var(--g)}
#mb{display:none;background:none;border:0;width:44px;height:44px;cursor:pointer}#mb i{display:block;width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--t);margin:6px auto}.stats{display:flex;gap:28px;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}.stats div{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--m);max-width:130px}.stats b{display:block;font:500 2.6rem "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--g);line-height:1}.tg{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.ct a.row{word-break:break-word}#lb button{position:fixed;top:10px;right:16px;background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:2.4rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}footer{border-top:1px solid var(--l);padding:26px 0;color:var(--m);font-size:.78rem;text-align:center}
#lb{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.94);z-index:50;display:none;overflow:auto;padding:30px;cursor:zoom-out}#lb.on{display:block}#lb img{display:block;margin:auto;max-width:min(1100px,100%);height:auto}
@media(max-width:780px){#mb{display:block}nav ul{display:none;position:absolute;top:68px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:#0e0e0e;border-bottom:1px solid var(--l)}nav ul.on{display:flex}nav li a{display:block;padding:16px 24px;font-size:.85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--l)}.ab,.ct,.web,.tg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ab,.ct{gap:36px}section{padding:64px 0}.hero{min-height:80vh}.gr{columns:2 140px;column-gap:10px}.it{margin-bottom:10px}.it small{opacity:1;font-size:.7rem;padding:18px 8px 6px}.tabs{overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap;padding-bottom:6px}.tabs .b{white-space:nowrap}.fr .in{display:none}#lb{padding:12px}.b{padding:12px 22px}}

<header class="hero" id="top"><div class="w"><div class="eb">Mahnoor Ansari · Portrait Artist &amp; Art Teacher</div><h1>Designer.<br>Developer.<br><em>Artist.</em></h1><p>Creating meaningful experiences through design, technology and imagination.</p><a class="b" href="#design">Explore my work</a></div></header>
<section id="about"><div class="w ab"><div><div class="eb">About me</div><h2>Where every line <span>finds a face.</span></h2>
<p>I'm Mahnoor Ansari, a portrait artist, art teacher and web developer from Karachi, Pakistan. I create expressive portraits with pencil, charcoal and paper, and I teach students to understand light, detail and emotion in drawing.</p>
<p>I also design logos and layouts and build websites and games with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I speak Urdu and English.</p>
<div class="stats"><div><b>1</b>Year teaching at The Educators</div><div><b>2</b>Portrait-sketching certificates</div><div><b>24</b>Artworks</div></div></div>
<div class="sk"><span>Portrait drawing</span><span>Graphite</span><span>Charcoal</span><span>Pastel</span><span>Digital art</span><span>Photoshop &amp; Illustrator (taught)</span><span>CorelDRAW</span><span>Adobe Express</span><span>HTML · CSS · JavaScript</span><span>Teaching</span></div></div></section>
<section id="design"><div class="w"><div class="eb">Graphic design</div><h2>Logos, layouts <span>&amp; posters.</span></h2><p class="sub">Logos in CorelDRAW, plus layout and poster work. Pieces marked Concept are self-initiated projects.</p>
<div class="tabs" data-t="design"><button class="b on" data-f="all">All</button><button class="b" data-f="corel">CorelDRAW</button><button class="b" data-f="layout">Layouts</button><button class="b" data-f="poster">Posters</button></div><div class="gr" id="gd"></div></div></section>
<section id="art"><div class="w"><div class="eb">Fine art &amp; sketches</div><h2>Pencil, charcoal <span>&amp; oil.</span></h2><p class="sub">Portraits and studies in pencil, charcoal, pastel and oil, from my sketchbooks and canvases.</p>
<div class="tabs" data-t="art"><button class="b on" data-f="all">All</button><button class="b" data-f="portrait">Portraits</button><button class="b" data-f="study">Studies</button><button class="b" data-f="painting">Paintings</button><button class="b" data-f="fun">Creative</button></div><div class="gr" id="ga"></div></div></section>
<section id="web"><div class="w"><div class="eb">Web development</div><h2>Built with <span>HTML, CSS &amp; JS.</span></h2><p class="sub">Four concept projects, live on the web. Click a preview to see the full page.</p><div class="web" id="gw"></div></div></section>
<section id="teaching"><div class="w"><div class="eb">Teaching</div><h2>Learn to draw <span>with me.</span></h2><p class="sub">Step-by-step lessons for beginners and advanced students. Classes run Monday to Saturday with flexible daytime hours.</p><div class="web tg"><article class="card"><div class="cb"><h3>Basic Portrait Sketching</h3><p>Face structure, proportions, pencil control and basic shading techniques.</p></div></article><article class="card"><div class="cb"><h3>Advanced Portrait Sketching</h3><p>Realistic facial features, hair, skin tones, expressions and charcoal depth.</p></div></article><article class="card"><div class="cb"><h3>Digital Art Basics</h3><p>An introduction to Photoshop, Illustrator and fundamental digital-art techniques.</p></div></article></div><p style="margin-top:28px"><a class="b" href="https://wa.me/923200380687?text=Hi%20Mahnoor%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20ask%20about%20your%20classes" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ask about classes on WhatsApp</a></p></div></section><section id="contact"><div class="w ct"><div><div class="eb">Contact</div><h2>Let's make <span>something.</span></h2><p class="sub">Open to collaborations, freelance work, students and opportunities. WhatsApp is the quickest way to reach me.</p></div><div><a class="row" href="https://wa.me/923200380687" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><small>WhatsApp (preferred)</small>0320 0380687</a><a class="row" href="mailto:ansarimahnoor58@gmail.com"><small>Email</small>ansarimahnoor58@gmail.com</a><a class="row" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/mahnoor-ansari-746543400" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><small>LinkedIn</small>Mahnoor Ansari</a><a class="row" href="https://www.facebook.com/share/1CPLjwEcz8/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><small>Facebook</small>Mahnoor Ansari</a><a class="row" href="https://github.com/mahn00ransari" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><small>GitHub</small>github.com/mahn00ransari</a></div></div></section>
